providers.reason: Xometry achieved a major milestone by reporting its first-ever quarter of GAAP profitability in Q3 2026. Revenue grew 40% year-over-year to $252 million, surpassing a $1 billion annual run rate. Exceptional marketplace gross margins of 36% and strong enterprise adoption (26% growth in large accounts) signal powerful operating leverage and scaling efficiency.
providers.risk: High valuation premium relative to intrinsic value may invite profit-taking after the recent 16% price surge.

providers.reason: Q3 EPS $0.28 vs $0.19 consensus, revenue +40% to a record $252M, first GAAP profit, record 36% marketplace gross margin, and Q4 guide of $254–256M above $247.8M consensus. Citi lifted its target to $132 from $110 with a Buy, supporting post-earnings drift.
providers.risk: Gapped 16.5% to $111 and closed well off the $116.55 intraday high; failure to hold the gap risks a fill toward the mid-$90s, and at roughly 6x sales the stock is priced for flawless execution.

providers.reason: Record Q3 with 40% revenue growth to $252M, first-ever GAAP profit, and raised FY guidance to 37% growth. Stock surged 16.5% post-earnings to near all-time highs, demonstrating strong momentum and clear market approval of results.
providers.risk: After 96% 12-month gain and 16.5% post-earnings surge, near-term pullback risk is elevated as gains may be fully priced in at current valuations.

providers.reason: Q3 revenue $252M, +40% y/y with 43% marketplace growth, record 36.0% margin and first $1.9M GAAP profit; raised FY revenue to ~37% and EBITDA to $68-68.5M, stock +16.55%.
providers.risk: Parabolic +16.5% post-earnings move invites profit-taking and mean-reversion on any guidance digestion.
